SPECIFICATION FOR m 
BICYCLE STEERING HEAD ASSEMBLY 
('R'TYPE) 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and other requirements for bicycle steering head assembly of 
'R' type. 

2. Nomenclature — The nomenclature for various components of the steering head assembly is in 
accordance with IS : 3798-1966 'Glossary of terms used in the bicycle industry'. 

3. Dimensions 

3.1 The ball race seatings shall conform to the dimensions given in Fig. 1 and 2. 



0.64 




All dimensions In millimetres. 
FIG. 1 BALL RACE SEATING (TOP) 

3.2 The races, crown and screwed, shall conform to Fig. 3 and 4. 

3.3 The lock nut shall conform to Fig. 5. 

3.4 The screw threads on the race shall comply with Fig. 6.

4.2 When a lamp bracket is included in the assembly, it shall be made of steel conforming to 
IS : 226-1975. 

5. Finish 

5.1 The top and bottom ball race seatings shall be nickel-chrome plated to Service Grade No. 1 
( Classification SNMObCrr) of IS : 1068-1985 'Specification for electroplated coatings of nickel plus 
chromium and copper plus nickel plus chromium on iron and steel ( second revision )*. 

5.2 The crown race and screwed race shall be nickel-chrome plated to Grade No. 1 ( Classification 
Fe/Ni10bCrr ) of IS : 1068-1985. Alternatively, the crown race may only be zinc plated to Service 
Grade No. 1 ( Classification Fe/Zn 5 ) of IS : 1573-1986 'Specification for electroplated coatings of 
zinc on iron and steel ( second revision )'. 



IS: 12474-1988 

5.3 The lock nut and the lamp bracket ( when fitted ) shall also be nickel and chrome plated to 
Service Grade No. 1 ( Classification SNMObCrr ) of IS : 1068-1985.

6. Tests 

6.1 The steering head assembly shall rotate freely after assembly (see also IS : 10616-1983 
Methods of tests for bicycles and sub assemblies ). 

7- Marking — Shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or trade-mark, and country 
of origin, etc. 

7.1 Standard Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

8- Packing — Shall be in accordance with the best prevalent trade practices. 

9. Sampling 

9.1 Unless otherwise agreed to between the supplier and the purchaser, the procedure given in 
IS : 2500 ( Part 1 )-1973 'Sampling inspection tables: Part 1 Inspection by attributes and by count 
of defects ( first revision ) * shall be followed for sampling inspection. 



IS: 12474- 1988 

9.1.1 For dimensions, finish and workmanship, inspection level IV and acceptable quality level 
( AQL } 2 5 percent as given in Tables 1 and 2 of IS : 2500 ( Part 1 )-1973 shall be followed.

9.1.2 For tests, Inspection level I and acceptable quality level (AQL) 2'5 percent as given in 
Tables 1 and 2 of IS : 2500 ( Part 1 )-1973 shall be followed. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The bicycle steering head assemblies used in popular brands In India are normally either 
'PH' or *R* type, In this standard, the 'R* type is covered. 'PH' type is covered separately in 
IS : 2973-1983 'Specification for bicycles steering head assembly ( PH type ) ( first revision )\ 

While formulating this standard, considerable assistance has been taken from the data 
supplied by the leading manufacturers of the product. 



Printed at New India Printing Press, Khurja, India
